checks.label: Physical units at the original ETA

Revised shipment ETA in simulated seconds
Available units after expiry and actual receipt

cases.description: A real worker process exits after writing stock but before committing. Its lease expires and another worker retries.

checks.label: Stock, basket and decision writes rolled back

cases.description: One household calls for pizza. A stocked kitchen should avoid unnecessary supermarket requests.

checks.label: No model or paid search reservations

checks.label: Household and restaurant approvals precede cooking

cases.description: Two real dispatcher workers claim different queued jobs concurrently while only one courier is online. The winner may vary.

checks.label: Jobs assigned to the available courier

cases.name: Traffic and judged retry
cases.description: Congestion doubles traversal time and two couriers drop out. Only a feasible approved retry should receive another courier.

checks.label: Every retry has a preceding approval
Every route uses the seeded traffic durations

cases.name: Accept only your own briefing

checks.label: Other courier briefing and acceptance denied

cases.name: Brief the replacement courier
cases.description: An approved retry carries the actual parcel checkpoint, prior courier and source events into its bounded handoff memory.

checks.label: Handoff parcel checkpoint matches the dropout
Replacement brief includes source events and approval
Arrivals fabricated for the abandoned order

cases.name: Finish only after physical arrival
cases.description: Couriers acknowledge their jobs and the trusted city advances them along roads. Delivery completion requires an arrival event.

checks.label: Every completed delivery has an arrival event
Route ETA equals the sum of edge durations
